context: Garden boutique landing page with WhatsApp CTA, custom order builder, catalog, testimonials, and FAQ
key_features: Kinetic hero with masked line-by-line reveal & WhatsApp priority CTA
Editorial marquee ribbon with botanical highlights
Interactive product catalog filtered by Bouquets, Hampers, and Flowers
Custom Order Builder with instant WhatsApp checkout estimation
Customer testimonials with verified review badges
Accordion FAQ covering same-day delivery & custom arrangements
